Lotus Root 12.5.2 · 20 Nov 2026

Lighter thin nodes, a faster web UI, per-chain charts

⬇ Download 12.5.2What is newQuick start
ImportantNapoleon, 2026-12-21 20:50 UTC: every node must run 12.5.1 or later before then. This version qualifies. Earlier versions, 12.4.x included, do not follow the chain after the fork.

Highlights

  • Thin nodes stop rewriting their disk. A thin node started from a snapshot no longer downloads old blocks again and again; its disk writes drop to what each new block needs.
  • Explorer: the first block is always indexed. The explorer tables no longer depend on start-up timing for the genesis block.
  • A responsive web UI under load. Idle browser and proxy connections no longer hold the node's request threads, so pages and the API answer at once while several tabs or a reverse proxy are connected.
  • Charts per parent chain. The difficulty and hashrate charts draw one series per chain (Lotus, Bitcoin, eCash, Bitcoin Cash, Litecoin), each in its own colour.
  • Accurate peer flags. A peer's country now comes from exact address ranges, for IPv4 and IPv6, with its network operator. The table is built into the node: no address leaves it.
  • Pages for tokens, blobs and games. Tokens, blobs, POKR and eMPP get their own pages, and a protocol transaction shows its payload decoded field by field.

Compatibility and rollback

Minimum version on the network12.5.1, required from Napoleon (2026-12-21 20:50 UTC)
NapoleonEvery node must run 12.5.1 or later before 2026-12-21 20:50 UTC. This version qualifies.
UpgradingStop the node, replace the binaries, start it. The data directory is kept.
Going backStop the node and put the previous binaries back. Going back is not always possible once a newer version has written to the data directory; the release says when.

Install and verify

Docker 
docker pull ghcr.io/lotusdevorg/lotusd:12.5.2
docker run -d --name lotusd -v lotus-data:/data ghcr.io/lotusdevorg/lotusd:12.5.2
Linux 
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/LotusDevOrg/lotusd-releases/releases/download/v12.5.2/SHA256SUMS
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/LotusDevOrg/lotusd-releases/releases/download/v12.5.2/lotus-binaries-12.5.2-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
sha256sum -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS     # must print: OK
tar -xzf lotus-binaries-12.5.2-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
./lotus-binaries-12.5.2-linux-x86_64/lotusd -version
macOS

The same steps with lotus-binaries-12.5.2-macos-x86_64.tar.gz; check with shasum -a 256 -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS. macOS asks for confirmation before the first launch (the binaries are not notarised).

Windows

Download lotus-binaries-12.5.2-windows-x86_64.zip and SHA256SUMS. In PowerShell, Get-FileHash .\lotus-binaries-12.5.2-windows-x86_64.zip -Algorithm SHA256 must give the value on that file's line. Then unzip.

Download Lotus binaries from github.com/LotusDevOrg/lotusd-releases only, and check them against SHA256SUMS.
